authorization.note: preregister + notebook hypothesis only; no fit, no replay, no orders until root reviews the information/unknown-sample contract and authorizes

objective: Test whether the single new point-in-time information feature log(VXNCLS/VIXCLS) adds net-of-fee information about SOXL-vs-SOXX that the matched price-only control cannot, using the existing fixed H5 reference method

single_new_information.pairing: same observation date, both legs from ALFRED Initial Release Only
single_new_information.source_state: latest actually-released-as-of only; unknown remains unknown (no zero fill, no forward fill, no current revision)

source_binding.float_precision: store fields are float32 (readback documented, no speculative extra feature)

rows.reason: real NYSE session value stamped released earlier; release field untrustworthy; quarantine signal, keep raw ZIP unchanged, do NOT rewrite first-release dates

quarantine.single_gap_retained: the single quarantined premature observation is retained as an explicit unknown/exclusion with its reason and hash; it is NOT silently deleted or backfilled

source_binding.availability_contract: available_at = 09:31 America/New_York of the first native session strictly after max(period_start_date, realtime_start_date); quarantined premature rows unavailable; unknown stays unknown

reference_method.note: existing fixed H5 method reused as the reference; H20 is closed and not reopened; no other horizon is attempted
reference_method.quote_clock: allocation quote after next open 09:31 America/New_York; prediction at prior signal 16:15

control.constraint: MUST use the same source-eligible training/validation samples AND the same source availability mask as the candidate; do NOT compare against the older 2011-start price-only control

arms.forbidden_comparison: candidate vs pre-existing 2011-start price control (extra 5 years of training would be attributed to information)

sample_contract.eligibility: train/validation include a row only if it is explicitly metadata-known source-eligible (source $known==1) AND its label is strictly mature
sample_contract.excluded_rows: counts + reasons + hash are audited; the single quarantined gap is never silently removed
sample_contract.dataset_full_calendar: the native calendar is retained with no row deletion
sample_contract.validation_prefix: the label-maturity prefix is verified independently first, then the SAME source-eligible mask is applied
sample_contract.two_heads_rowset: control(25) and candidate(26) use the exact same eligible row set; the rowset hash must be equal across both heads
sample_contract.feature_availability: known row feature_available_at = max(price close 16:00, source 09:31 state-available); source-unknown column kept as NaN
sample_contract.unknown_rows: the model must NOT predict unknown rows; no placeholder zero is treated as a prediction; the forecast table marks such rows NaN / model_not_used
sample_contract.hold_risk_trace: a null policy/planning placeholder is allowed in the hold risk trace, but the forecast table must be NaN with a model-not-used note
sample_contract.fallback: unknown source or insufficient labels trigger the pre-declared pure-SOXX fallback only at the pre-registered H5 rebalance decision; HOLD keeps the real position with zero fee; both arms use the identical mask/strategy; 2016 both arms are pure SOXX with no fake forecasts and no model
sample_contract.no_fabrication: never zero-fill, never forward-fill with revisions, never shrink the window

schedule.fallback_note: 2016 inner fit cutoff Jan1 2015 NewYork has fewer than252 strictly mature source-eligible rows; first observation2014-04-18 is not first available signal2014-04-22. Both arms pureSOXX at existing H5 decisions; no2016 model.

fit_budget.note: inner must be data-driven, not default-filled; no cross-year borrowing or shrinkage of the minimum

native_cases.structure: 2 windows x 2 cost_bps x {candidate, matched control, SOXX}

full_checks: positive net log excess at both costs
max drawdown not worse than SOXX
gates.parent_identity: the H5 parent is a METHOD reference only; this experiment computes a NEW matched baseline separately and does not claim to reproduce parent performance

diagnostics_separation.signal_diagnostics: reported against the matched control and the model's own prior separately
diagnostics_separation.no_post_hoc: no sign flip, no spread changes of 20, no threshold tuning based on results

stopping: If the candidate fails the historical/diagnostic net-excess gates, record not_promoted and stop; no horizon/alpha/threshold search

new_information_feature.usage: candidate adds exactly this one known-source ratio to the 25 price features; no speculative extra features

incremental_requirement.response: five-session simple return SOXL minus SOXX
incremental_requirement.eligible: same model-used and mature rows in both arms;2016 fallback excluded only from forecast diagnostics, never portfolio path
incremental_requirement.mse_rule: In EACH window candidate excess-response MSE / matched-control MSE < 1-1e-8 AND candidate excess-response MSE / candidate own training historical-mean prior MSE < 1-1e-8. Nonfinite or zero reference MSE blocks. No alternative IC pass.
incremental_requirement.ic_rule: Spearman IC reported for SOXL, SOXX and excess response only; not an alternative acceptance gate or claim of significance
incremental_requirement.portfolio_rule: In EACH window and EACH cost candidate net log excess over matched control >1e-8, in addition to all unchanged SOXX gates.
incremental_requirement.combination: ALL conditions required; failure closes this single source route

decision_rule.no_post_hoc: no sign flip, no spread-of-20 selection, no threshold tuning
